summary: Mia Bonta was identified as a skeptic of AB 715, the antisemitism-coordinator and classroom-material oversight bill, and pressed co-authors to clean up the text after its late-night passage, yet ultimately voted aye. Vote for Peace rated her an Ally and CAIR Action preferred her in the general. Her documented reservations about the bill, over which the debate concerned speech about Palestine, alongside those positive pro-Palestine ratings, reflect a middle position on Palestinian justice.
